news.title: Jharkhand government targets one lakh new PMAY-Urban houses approval this year
news.para: Jharkhand aims for one lakh new Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Urban houses this year.  Urban local bodies will invite fresh applications from eligible families.  Construction of nearly fourteen thousand houses will reach roof level soon.  Funds are available, and beneficiaries' payments must be expedited.  Banks will receive more home loan applications for affordable housing projects.

news.title: No immediate relief for Ram Charan, Chamundi in Boulder Hills plots case
news.para: Actor Ram Charan and former cricketer Chamundeswaranath faced a setback as their plea for villa plots was turned down. The SAFEMA Appellate Tribunal is set to review their claims as bona fide purchasers. These premium plots, totaling more than fourteen crore rupees, require buyers to validate their transactions with legitimate funds. The special court is scheduled to examine their case and presented evidence.

news.title: SC pulls up banks over alleged nexus with builders in real estate cases
news.para: In a significant ruling, the Supreme Court has ordered lenders to proceed with prosecuting their officers implicated in a questionable alliance with builders. The court's directive includes the allocation of extra police forces to bolster the CBI's ongoing probe. Additionally, pertinent case details will be handed over to the Enforcement Directorate, as the CBI scrutinizes allegations tied to certain real estate firms.

news.title: Specialised real estate platforms drive India's next wave of IPOs
news.para: India's real estate sector is on the rise, with innovative public market listings through specialized platforms. These enterprises demonstrate stability with recurring revenue and institutional support, drawing in investors. The surge began with flexible workspace providers post-pandemic, while residential developers and student housing firms are now eyeing their own listings. This movement creates new avenues for investment in the unfolding realty growth landscape.

news.title: Luxury hotel chains bet big on India's wellness boom
news.para: Indian luxury hotel chains are investing heavily in wellness tourism.  The Oberoi Group plans twenty new lifestyle resorts across India and abroad.  Indian Hotels Company is expanding its Atmantan wellness brand with new centers.  Developers are integrating wellness facilities into luxury hospitality projects.  This expansion caters to growing traveler demand for wellness experiences.

news.title: Eicher Motors leases four lakh sq ft in Sriperumbudur industrial park
news.para: Eicher Motors secured nearly 400,000 sq ft on lease in Sriperumbudur. This expansion supports Royal Enfield's growing manufacturing footprint in Tamil Nadu. The company will invest significantly in a new plant in Andhra Pradesh. This new facility will boost Royal Enfield's total annual motorcycle capacity. Sriperumbudur remains a key manufacturing hub attracting automotive investments.

news.title: About 60% of nearly 600 realty projects under scrutiny in Kolkata likely to get clearance soon: CREDAI West Bengal
news.para: Most Kolkata real estate projects under scrutiny will soon receive clearance. Approximately sixty percent of these projects have already passed technical review stages. Remaining projects are expected to gain approval before an August fifteenth deadline. This review process was mandated by the Kolkata Municipal Corporation after a warehouse collapse.

news.title: UK's Persimmon pretax profit rise 3% to £170.1 million in January-June 2026
news.para: Persimmon is projecting that home completions for 2026 will reach 12,500 units. However, the rising costs associated with inflation could lead to a profit reduction of fifty million pounds. This financial strain may hinder the company from achieving its target of a twenty percent operating margin. Recently, there has been a decline in buyer inquiries, which has affected sales in the open market.

news.title: Property Share files for ₹485-crore IPO of fourth SM REIT scheme
news.para: Property Share Investment Trust has introduced its draft IPO for the latest initiative, PropShare Lumina, aiming to secure as much as Rs 485 crore. This scheme uniquely grants investors access to commercial properties that were once available only to institutional players. The investment includes shares in two business center towers situated in Noida, with plans for trading on the BSE.

news.title: Sebi proposes investment by REITs, InvITs in third party projects without controlling interest
news.para: Sebi has put forth a proposal that would permit REITs and InvITs to channel investments into under-construction assets, enhancing pipeline security. It also recommends shortening the cooling-off period for privately placed InvITs. Additionally, remote common infrastructure is now classified as real estate for REITs.

news.title: Over 10 lakh beneficiaries in West Bengal receive financial assistance under Paschim Banga Awas scheme
news.para: West Bengal's housing scheme, Banglar Bari, is now Paschim Banga Awas. Over ten lakh beneficiaries received their final financial assistance today. The state plans to release more funds for new beneficiaries after Durga Puja. Beneficiaries will receive Rs 1.20 lakh in total for house construction. The government aims to ensure genuine applicants receive benefits without discrimination.

news.title: Maharashtra minister directs action against developers not handing over MHADA homes
news.para: Maharashtra minister Mangal Prabhat Lodha has directed authorities to initiate strict legal action against developers failing to hand over homes reserved for MHADA. The direction came during MHADA Mumbai Board’s lottery for 2,640 homes, which received 75,127 applications.

news.title: Signature Global reports ₹16.52 crore net loss in Q1 FY27
news.para: Signature Global (India)'s consolidated total income declined 31.9 per cent to ₹611.72 crore during the quarter. Its pre-sales increased 25 per cent sequentially to ₹1,970 crore.

news.title: CP Kukreja Architects’ portfolio may grow over 50% in FY27: Dikshu C. Kukreja
news.para: CP Kukreja Architects is currently working on projects spanning over 100 million sq ft, said Dikshu C. Kukreja, managing principal, C P Kukreja Architects. He said the firm’s order book has grown 35-40%, while its portfolio is expected to grow over 50% between FY26 and FY27.

news.title: Eleven firms eye Ujjain IT Park, seek 1.26 lakh sq ft
news.para: Ujjain's IT Park is witnessing impressive early interest from eleven technology firms, all aiming for considerable built-up space and promising substantial investments. This initiative is anticipated to generate more than three thousand new jobs, encouraging the state government to hasten the second phase of development. The expansion will enhance available space and further stimulate the local economy significantly.

news.title: Office assets account for over 40% of real estate investments in India in H1 2026: Report
news.para: Real estate investments in Asia Pacific reached $105 billion in H1 2026, the strongest first half since 2022, according to Colliers. In India, office assets accounted for over 40% of total real estate investments during the period.

news.title: Kripa Electronics leases 5,682 sq ft office space in Mumbai for ₹14.8 crore
news.para: Kripa Electronics India has leased office space at Kanakia Wallstreet, Andheri East, Mumbai, for five years. The total rental value over the lease tenure is estimated at about ₹14.80 crore.

news.title: Patna-based builder held in ₹5 crore property fraud cases
news.para: A city builder has been taken into custody for alleged involvement in property fraud. The accused reportedly gathered funds from clients without fulfilling land delivery promises, amassing over five crore rupees in total across five separate cases. Following a court-issued arrest warrant, police have apprehended him, and investigators are now probing additional complaints associated with his dealings.

news.title: SC asks Bhopal civic body to continue action on commercial shops in residential areas
news.para: The Supreme Court has instructed the Bhopal Municipal Corporation to maintain its enforcement efforts. Over a thousand businesses located within residential areas have been served notices, leading to the sealing of more than ten commercial properties. The state government has also established a specialized committee to investigate the matter further, as the court emphasized the need for the corporation to adhere to its compliance orders.

news.title: Lucknow development body plans action against illegal buildings in Aliganj
news.para: In response to violations of land-use regulations on residential plots in Aliganj, the Lucknow Development Authority is taking decisive action against illegal commercial structures. Following a tragic fire incident, the Supreme Court mandated this intervention. Currently, the LDA has identified fifty-one such buildings and is devising a thorough action plan, while enforcement teams continue to evaluate these properties for potential sealing or demolition.
